n: Experience AI Discovering AI single lessons
t: Single Experience AI lessons on data and predictions for ages 8 to 16.
steps: Find Experience AI at the Raspberry Pi Foundation.
Sign up for a free account.
Choose the Discovering AI lesson for your age group.
Download the lesson plan, slides, and activities.
Check whether any activity needs a device. The research team did not confirm this.
Teach the sections in order and finish with the exit ticket.
